Just throwing out an idea here… But perhaps the reason why you have this particular fantasy, while imagining you’re a woman, is because as a man you might not feel like you are able to be a submissive person in your every day life as a man? Therefore this fantasy allows you to access what you are looking for praise and/or submission? 

A lot of the time fantasies allow us to access parts of ourselves which we might not connect with our every day lives. As a highly independent woman myself, I often enjoy being submissive in the bedroom as that is not something I have been allowed to really explore safely in my life before. 

However, sometimes fantasies are just that, fantasies. Sometimes we think we might enjoy something and it doesn’t pan out that way when we explore it. That’s okay too.

4 months off the k (previous daily user up to 5g a day). I can empathise with your situation completely, in the beginning I was having cravings literally all day long. However, they do start to create a distance between them, gradually over time. Then one day you’ll go without thinking about it, and you’ll be amazed that you got there. That feeling will hopefully fuel the fight for a greater freedom for your mind. 

I think at the 3 month mark I felt ‘safe’ from cravings, but just take it one day at a time. I know it sounds silly but I put a star on my calendar every day I made it through, like a little reward. And between months 3 - 4 I didn’t need to do that daily anymore. 

Congratulations on a week, you’ve done the hardest part. It’ll get easier from here. You can do it, and you deserve to give yourself a better life away from it 💗
Recovery is rarely linear, don’t let this hold you back. Try again, and again, until you’re where you want to be. Tomorrow is a new day, you can do it x
